idea-plugin.name: EN 16931 e-Invoice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Checks an invoice payload or field mapping against EN 16931 and the national CIUS of the country it detects — 29 rules, in your editor.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EN 16931 e-Invoice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/en16931-einvoice-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/en16931-einvoice-lint

action.text: EN 16931 e-Invoice Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EN 16931 e-Invoice Lint on the file in the editor
